findings.description: F001's D034/D035 pending rule lets consumer=both close when the agent family is proven but the human family is not_yet_typed, while the objective contract says consumer=both requires both families proven and a missing family yields consumer_outcome_unproven unless structurally deferred or dispositioned.
findings.recommendation: Resolve the contract before lock: either amend the objective contract to explicitly allow the platform-level human-not-yet-typed pending exception, or make F001 block unless a structured deferral/disposition exists.

findings.description: Product metadata is listed as an activation and posture input, but the proposed feature does not define the concrete metadata keys, parser, or close_plan wiring that makes product/migration/readiness/ux/consumer-facing delivery deterministic.
findings.recommendation: Pin the product_metadata schema and extraction path, then add a metadata-only activation test so product claims cannot dodge enforcement through non-goal_type metadata.

findings.description: The required evidence calls for product-class blocking on substrate-only evidence, but the listed tests cover API-only, seeded-only, typed-skip-only, real capture, and degraded honesty without a dedicated substrate-only product-class close-block case.
findings.recommendation: Add a deterministic close_plan test where a product-class journey is covered only by substrate/internal evidence and verify consumer_outcome_unproven plus blocked status flip.
